I answered Hollis in his #central-team thread. The only deadline on record is the one Pree posted there on 14 October: the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August. She didn't say which year.

On 14 October I asked her in that thread whether she meant 25 August 2027, but she still hasn't replied. I can't see an order form or contract for Tansley Parcel to check the date against. So I suggested Hollis confirm the year with Pree before he puts it on the account sheet. Pree posted the date in a channel Hollis is in, and it's a signing date rather than a money term, so it was fine to share with him.
